abstract: Maintains statutory drilling notification filings and environmental regulator permissions
system_message:
You are the EPA Liaison Officer (REG), responsible for maintaining statutory drilling notification filings and environmental regulator permissions, as well as tracking historical spill archives across candidate groundwater contaminant plume source localization strategies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Historical spill archive（ARCH）
information_points.content:
REG-ARCH-1IS：According to the historical spill archive from 1980 to 2025, Direct-push multi-level piezometer profiling has an associated historical incident record count of 8 records representing logged chemical discharge events within five hundred meters.
REG-ARCH-YYL：For Cross-borehole electrical resistivity tomography with discrete micro-purging, the historical spill archive records show a historical incident record count of 4 records of logged chemical discharge events within five hundred meters between 1980 and 2025.
REG-ARCH-PP7：In the historical spill archive covering 1980 to 2025, High-resolution passive diffusion bag transect reflects a historical incident record count of 12 records documenting logged chemical discharge events within five hundred meters.

information_points.title: Maintains statutory drilling notification filings and environmental regulator permissions（EPAC）
information_points.content:
REG-EPAC-7JS：For Direct-push multi-level piezometer profiling, statutory drilling notification filing has been completed for proposed invasive drilling and soil coring works, with formal receipt and acknowledgment of thirty-day prior notification from the environmental protection authority confirmed.
REG-EPAC-BUZ：For Cross-borehole electrical resistivity tomography with discrete micro-purging, statutory drilling notification filing is confirmed, having obtained formal receipt and acknowledgment of thirty-day prior notification from the environmental protection authority for proposed invasive drilling and soil coring works.
REG-EPAC-CAK：For High-resolution passive diffusion bag transect, statutory drilling notification filing has not been completed, lacking formal receipt and acknowledgment of thirty-day prior notification from the environmental protection authority for proposed invasive drilling and soil coring works.
